sources.title: smshahbaj/Rifa-Nano-0.5B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 📖 Overview RIFA Nano is the smallest and fastest model in the RIFA series — a family of language models built to run efficiently across a wide range of hardware, from low-end mobile devices to modern GPUs. sources.title: Meta's Llama 3.2 goes small with 1B and 3B models.
sources.snippet: The Llama 3.2 instruction-tuned text only models are optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases, including agentic retrieval and summarization tasks. They outperform many of the available open source and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks.
